runs.note: FIRST RUN FROM THE SECONDARY WORKTREE. This run executes in c:\Users\tvolo\dev\ai-dala\letflow-wt2, a git worktree of the same repository as the primary checkout, with a concurrent ORCH session running in the primary checkout under queue agent_id tvolodi-orch. Claimed live via a real letflow-queue get_next_task call (agent_id: worktree2-orch), task id 38 (REQ-023, depends_on: [36] = REQ-022, done) -- the queue's atomic claim, not this local registry, is what prevents the two worktrees from claiming the same requirement. IMPORTANT for anyone reading this file for ORCHESTRATOR.md Sec.7 collision checks: this registry is per-checkout and is only merged across worktrees when each side pushes, so it CANNOT see the other worktree's in-flight owned_modules until that run lands on main. Treat Sec.7 as a best-effort local safety net here, not a cross-worktree guarantee; the queue claim is the real lock. owned_modules for this run (lib/letflow/event_store, priv/repo/migrations) were chosen to be additive-only -- new files under a new directory plus new timestamped migration files -- so a concurrent run touching a different lib/letflow/ subtree cannot conflict at the file level. Baseline before any change: mix test --seed 0 = 161/161 against letflow_test2; one unpinned-seed run reproduced pre-existing ISS-0011 only.
